R143.note: .NET (net8, per the file's own comment) does not verify strong-name signatures at Assembly.Load time - GetPublicKeyToken() just reads embedded metadata, so an attacker can embed the non-secret public key into a forged assembly and match the expected token without ever holding the private key, so the check provides no real cryptographic guarantee.
